offers.name: ASUS Zephyrus G16 16" Gaming Laptop - Eclipse Grey (Intel Core Ultra 9 285H/32GB RAM/1TB SSD/GeForce RTX 5060)

reviews.quote: The ROG Zephyrus G16's 2025 update offers several upgrades... it's still important to know that it uses a relatively slow version of the GPU. Other improvements include Wi-Fi 7, 64 GB of RAM, and longer battery life. The input devices and speakers remain very good. (NBC 'very good' 90%, tested GU605CX RTX 5090 config.)

professional.note: Line-level anchor from NBC's RTX 5090-config review; per-tier GPU deltas applied (see rating_notes).

praises: 2.5K OLED 240Hz screen repeatedly called the best display in this price class — inky blacks, vivid color, buttery smooth
Premium aluminum chassis at ~1.85 kg is genuinely portable for a 16-inch gaming laptop
Speakers and keyboard/trackpad among the best on any gaming laptop (NBC: 'excellent speakers', 'brilliant input devices')
90Wh battery gives ~6-8h light use with USB-C charging — unusually good for a gaming laptop
1TB + 32GB is the sensible 5060 tier: no immediate storage upgrade needed and a free second M.2 slot
complaints: $3,400 for an RTX 5060 draws constant comparison to thicker Strix G16 / Legion 5 with the same GPU for less
GPU TGP-capped in the slim chassis — the 5060 trails same-GPU thicker laptops in sustained FPS
Soldered RAM: no upgrade path ever (2x M.2 helps storage only)
PWM flickering on the OLED bothers light-sensitive users; HDR peak brightness is limited (NBC cons)
Lid creak and hinge rocking noted by NBC; fan speed pulses audibly at idle in some power profiles

design_philosophy: ASUS's halo slim 16-inch gaming line: aluminum unibody, OLED-first, ~1.85 kg — trading raw TGP and ports for portability and screen quality. This config is the better-balanced 5060 tier (1TB vs 512GB) at full regular price; the GPU remains the compromise of the line's thin-first philosophy.
rating_notes: Inferred from NBC GU605CX (RTX 5090) 90% anchor per SHARED-zephyrus-g16.md: -3.3 gaming for TGP-capped 5060, 8GB VRAM caps ai_ml, +0.2 creative_work vs the 512GB sibling (sku 19826851) for the 1TB. Battery from NBC lab 9h WiFi minus real-world calibration. Nearly identical to entry 92 except storage/tier price.
